structured_output.what_is_happening: A 12.6-minute-old copy of the "Effective Accelerationism (e/acc)" token, launched straight onto a PumpSwap pool rather than the pump.fun bonding curve. The canonical e/acc token (CbcyNo…, about $9.2M market cap, $1.3M hourly volume, created about 3.6 hours earlier) is clearly the main one. This copy is up about 85% in its first hour to roughly $28k market cap, with $38k of liquidity whose LP is 100% unlocked. Of 876 holders, 867 are fresh wallets, and GMGN flags 45 bundler wallets. The dev wallet holds nothing and its status is "creator_close". The description routes fees to @beffjezos through UsePaid, a fee-to-creator attribution scheme.

narrative.description: e/acc / Beff Jezos meme, a strong existing tech-culture narrative. It is plainly active right now because a same-name token reached $9M+ within hours. This token is a late copy trying to catch spillover flow.
narrative.why_spreading: The canonical e/acc token is running hard, so copycats and beta plays are appearing. This copy has no unique angle apart from claiming fees go to beffjezos.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker as the running canonical token. The fee-to-@beffjezos description may pull in some buyers who think it is the endorsed one.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo… ($9.2M, the dominant token), AQJ7… pump ($99k, 395k hourly volume, an earlier copycat), GqmE… (the old 2024 version), and two dead copies.

authenticity.evidence: 867 of 876 holders are fresh wallets and 45 are bundlers. 871 unique buyers in 15 minutes on a $28k coin is not believable as organic demand. There are no smart or renowned wallets. The token was created directly on PumpSwap with dev-held, unlocked LP, and liquidity ($38k) is higher than market cap. GeckoTerminal's holder snapshot showed top-10 at 99% early on.
authenticity.uncertainty: Fresh wallets can also be ordinary bot traders chasing the e/acc wave. Without X data I cannot confirm whether @beffjezos acknowledged this token.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked on a dev-created PumpSwap pool, so liquidity can be pulled at any time
Copycat of a much larger canonical token
Holder base is almost entirely fresh wallets, with 45 bundlers
The deployer has already closed out (creator_close)

structured_output.counterargument: The e/acc wave is live. The canonical token has $1.3M hourly volume and spillover buyers are pushing copies up; AQJ7 reached about $99k. Mint and freeze authority are renounced, the dev holds no tokens, and liquidity is deep for a $28k market cap, so the price could plausibly double to about $56k on beta flow within 6 hours. That is especially true if Beff Jezos acknowledges the fee routing.
unknowns: Who holds the LP tokens and whether they will pull liquidity
Whether @beffjezos acknowledges this token or its fees
Whether the canonical e/acc token keeps running or reverses

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat of a running narrative token. It was launched straight onto a PumpSwap pool with unlocked, dev-controlled LP and a wallet base that looks farmed. The chance of an LP pull or a fade after the pump is high, and the canonical token will soak up most real e/acc demand. Some chance of a 2x on spillover remains, but it is below this pool's average.
